role: OSDR spaceflight development probe for Tier-1 axis selection; not final confirmation

cohort.label: exact structured spaceflight versus ground-control label

candidates.tissue_site: casefolded exact OSDR material-type metadata; no inferred mapping
candidates.sex: casefolded exact OSDR sex metadata; no inferred mapping
candidates.age_bracket: casefolded exact age-at-launch string; missing is an explicit category; no inferred numeric conversion
candidates.hallmark_50: per-sample mean OSDR log1p expression across visible non-score member genes; each program is subsequently fold-fit standardized with the probe head

head.model: elastic-net logistic regression with balanced class weights

advance_gate: candidate AUROC minus organ-only AUROC is strictly positive; training-screen gates remain independently required
